description: Plūdu riska zonas is a dataset listed in Latvian Geospatial Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo-dpps.viss.gov.lv. Flood risk zone shape file is a vector data format consisting of areas that include depth classes, which can be used in formatting accordingly, in order to visually better demonstrate the water depths of flooded areas, calculate volume and area, as well as use for other calculations, such as determining economic losses. Coverage: LV. The portal shows the English title as "Flood risk areas" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2020-12-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/conditionsUnknown). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geolatvija.
